subject: S09 reopen item 2: adding an exam_active guard in qbank/routes.py (tutor create/single/weak-spot/attempts)
body: Per lead decision 20261117T005851 item 2: while active_exam() holds a timed/exam session (running, paused or on a break), POST /api/blocks (tutor), /blocks/weak-spot (tutor), /blocks/single and tutor POST /attempts answer 409 code exam_active; starting/creating a second timed/exam block also 409 exam_active (item 6). Implementation is one call  at the top of those handlers (helper in qbank/exam_state.py); no other changes to your logic. I hold a claim on routes.py for ~4 h; tell me if you are editing the same handlers so we sequence.
